samples.question: Left of the gray line, the arrow shows one black shape before and after a single move. The move is one of these: a quarter turn clockwise, a quarter turn counter-clockwise, a half turn, or a mirror flip across one of the square's four axes. Work out which move it was. Now apply that same move to the square right of the gray line, which holds four colored dots near its corners; the square lands back on itself and only its contents move. After the move, which color sits in the top-left corner? Answer blue, green, red, or yellow.
